description: PostgreSQL database schema, migrations, and connection config

root_level_dependencies.name: pg
root_level_dependencies.reason: PostgreSQL client library for Node.js backend service

root_level_dependencies.name: ts-node
root_level_dependencies.reason: TypeScript runner for migration scripts during CI/CD and local development

root_level_env_vars.name: DB_HOST
root_level_env_vars.description: PostgreSQL host (used if DATABASE_URL not set)

root_level_env_vars.name: DB_USER
root_level_env_vars.description: PostgreSQL username (used if DATABASE_URL not set)

root_level_env_vars.name: DB_PASSWORD
root_level_env_vars.description: PostgreSQL password (used if DATABASE_URL not set)

root_level_env_vars.name: DB_SSL_CERT_PATH
root_level_env_vars.description: Path to CA certificate file (if using custom certificates)

notes: Migrations are applied in order via src/migrate.ts and tracked in schema_migrations table
All monetary amounts stored as integer cents, never floating-point
Foreign keys use ON DELETE CASCADE for user-owned tables, RESTRICT for category/transaction references
Soft-delete support for GDPR compliance via deleted_at column on users table
Indexes optimized for dashboard aggregation and transaction history pagination
Connection pool tunable via DB_POOL_MAX, DB_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS, DB_CONNECTION_TIMEOUT_MS
